node.statement: Let T := {Q: |chi(p_Q)| > L}, split it as T_- := {Q in T: d_Q<0}, T_+ := {Q in T: d_Q>0}, and T_0 := {Q in T: d_Q=0}, and put c_Q := sum_{j in Q}P_vj. The tail cap, the negative-mass subset budgets, A>=4, and R := p_f-p_v+A(q-p_v) with ||R||_1 <= K_R*delta imply sum_{Q in T}|d_Q| <= [K_C+1+(K_C+K_R+1)/4]*delta = B*delta.
